During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''conflict''' broke out over the mystical [[Fount of Rajivari]] on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. A prelude to the larger [[Flesh Raider uprising]], the conflict began when the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|pilgrim]] [[Nalen Raloch]] was seduced to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by the teachings of [[Rajivari]], one of the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to fall to the dark side. Angry that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] refused to aid the people of [[Kalikori village]], Raloch attempted to destroy the ancient machine known as the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]] before he was stopped by the [[The Barsen'thor|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]], who had been searching for the Fount as well.
